title: Recursive canonical block tree
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate one of three states: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. With fuel $m$, define a coordinate decision tree recursively. At fuel zero, its leaf is the value of $\varphi$ on the completion of $\rho$ by the zero vector. At positive fuel, if no term is compatible with $\rho$, return the leaf $1$; otherwise select the compatible term of least index. If it has no free literal positions, return the leaf $-1$. If it has free literal positions, query their coordinates in order, beginning from the zero vector; after those queries, fix the queried coordinates according to the resulting vector, return the leaf $-1$ if the selected term is compatible with the updated restriction, and otherwise continue recursively with one less unit of fuel and that updated restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables
A coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate a state
